init_adb_server: initialize the adb server daemon on a given port before launching the simulator
execute_adb_command: execute an adb command with retry logic and automatic server restart on failure
get_command_prefix: get the adb command prefix list with optional device name and server port arguments
restart_adb_server: kill and restart the adb server daemon and verify connected devices
create_adb_controller: create an AdbController instance with config to manage adb communication with an Android device
